posts.caption:
Every dot is a day someone bought JPMorgan stock, 5,768 of them from 1980 to 2003. Red means that buyer is losing money.

One day later: 46% are red.
Ten years: still 1,176 red.

At 23 years and 2 months, not one dot is losing.

The last red dot bought in January 1986 and was red for over twenty three years. Still red at the very bottom of the financial crisis.

Every single person who waited made money.

Split-adjusted price, dividends excluded.

Follow for the next one.

Follow for the next one. Every claim on here gets tested against a control.

Follow for a new chart every day.
